statement.zh: Delougaz《迪亚拉地区陶器》OIP 63（1952）合刊哈法杰、阿斯马尔、阿格拉卜与伊什查利的陶器形制与分期。
statement.en: Delougaz, Pottery from the Diyala Region, OIP 63 (1952), publishes pottery forms and periodization from Khafajah, Tell Asmar, Tell Agrab, and Ishchali.

editorial.notes: Density pass 4; contested material kept as hypothesis where applicable.
